اشتكيت (form VIII)
# اِشْتَكَيْتُ (ištakaytu) /iʃ.ta.kaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# اِشْتَكَيْتَ (ištakayta) /iʃ.ta.kaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# اِشْتَكَيْتِ (ištakayti) /iʃ.ta.kaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْتَكَى (ištakā)
# اُشْتُكِيتُ (uštukītu) /uʃ.tu.kiː.tu/: first-person singular
